response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT `ANA Pattern` AS pattern, AVG(`aCL IgG`) AS avg_igg FROM Examination WHERE `ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(`ANA Pattern`) <> '' GROUP BY `ANA Pattern`), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) AS overall_mean FROM g), k AS (SELECT g.pattern, g.avg_igg, m.overall_mean FROM g, m WHERE g.avg_igg > m.overall_mean), km AS (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) AS kept_mean FROM k) SELECT k.pattern, k.avg_igg AS avg_aCL_IgG, k.avg_igg - k.overall_mean AS above_overall_mean, k.avg_igg - km.kept_mean AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM k, km ORDER BY k.avg_igg DESC
